name: Audio MFCC Rate Encoding
description: Rate coding preset for MFCC audio features. Maps coefficient values to firing rates up to 300 Hz with 3 ms refractory period. Optimal for keyword spotting on Google Speech Commands v2.

data.notes: Prevents saturation via 3 ms refractory period.

name: Biomedical Delta Encoding
description: Delta (change-based) encoding for biosignals (ECG, EEG). Emits a spike when signal changes by ≥5% of full scale. Low 5 ms refractory period preserves fine temporal structure in cardiac and neural signals.

data.notes: 5% delta threshold; 5 ms refractory preserves ECG morphology.

name: Fast-Signal Temporal (Phase) Encoding
description: Temporal/phase coding preset for fast, transient signals (EMG, vibration). Divides the signal into 8 phase bins and fires one spike per bin, timed earlier for higher amplitude — per neurocnl.spike_encoding.temporal_encode()'s default n_phases=8.

data.notes: Divides the signal into 8 phase bins; spike timing within each bin encodes amplitude (earlier spike = higher amplitude). Suited to fast/transient signals such as EMG or vibration, per the source module's own guidance.
